_webhook_help: Leave empty when running on GitHub (it uses the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL secret). Paste it here only if running on your PC.
_keywords_help: Case-insensitive regexes. A post is forwarded if ANY of them matches.
_mention_help: Optional ping, e.g. "@everyone" or "<@&ROLE_ID>". Leave empty for no ping.
_sources_help: claude-resets.com is a free community tracker of resets announced by @ClaudeDevs and Claude Code team members. It already contains only resets, so the keyword check is skipped for it.
